Gallery

Source: vignettes/articles/gallery.Rmd
gallery.Rmd

Every chart in ddplot, grouped by what it is for and ordered by how often you are likely to need it. Click a card to see the chart’s guide with live examples, or open its reference page for the full list of arguments.

Time seriesinteractiveshiny

Line chart

You track one or many series over time and want to zoom, compare and annotate.

line_chart()
Time series

Area chart

A single series where the volume under the line matters.

area_chart()
Time seriesinteractive

Stacked area chart

You show a total and how each component contributes over time.

stacked_area_chart()
Time series

Area band

You show a range over time, such as a min/max or an interval.

area_band()
Time seriesinteractive

Streamgraph

Many categories change over time and the overall shape matters more than exact values.

streamgraph()
Time seriesinteractive

Calendar heatmap

You look for daily, weekly or seasonal patterns in a daily series.

calendar_heatmap()
Time seriesanimated

Animated line chart

You present a single series and want it to draw itself on click.

anim_line_chart()
Comparisons

Bar chart

You compare a value across a handful of categories.

bar_chart()
Comparisons

Horizontal bar chart

You have many categories or long labels.

horz_bar_chart()
Comparisons

Lollipop chart

You want a lighter alternative to a bar chart.

lollipop_chart()

Horizontal lollipop

A lollipop chart with many categories or long labels.

horz_lollipop()

Dumbbell chart

dumbbell_chart()

Slope chart

slope_chart()

Bump chart

bump_chart()

Waterfall chart

waterfall_chart()

Radar chart

radar_chart()

Radial bar chart
